title: Scalar extension preserves local finite presentation
statement: Let X be a scheme and φ:R→S a morphism of ring objects in abelian sheaves on X_proet, with R commutative [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]. If an internal R-module M is locally finitely presented on a pro-etale cover [def-sfb-locally-finitely-presented], then Ext_φ(M) is locally finitely presented as an S-module. No flatness or noetherian assumption is imposed.

source.place: Sections 6.5 and 6.8, finite-presentation scalar extension; the existing heart-level proof in BoundedConstructibleExtendScalars.lean

proof.text: Scalar extension is additive and preserves colimits. The bimodule right unitor identifies the scalar extension of the regular R-module with the regular S-module. Mapping a finite free cokernel presentation and conjugating by the finite-biproduct isomorphisms therefore gives a finite free presentation after scalar extension.

On each member of the original presentation cover, use the inverse-image scalar-extension comparison to identify the restriction of Ext_φ(M) with the extension of the given restricted finite presentation. Transport that finite presentation across the isomorphism. This includes zero ranks and empty covers.
